Those are spawned\nas a single object with the alternates attached as TTS states, so you can\nright-click to swap when the unit transforms.\n\nSource models are never consumed: each is taken from its bag, serialised,\nreturned, and then respawned from that JSON as many times as the list needs.\n--]]\n\n-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- config --\n\nlocal CONFIG = {\n    perRow       = 5,      -- models per row within one combat group's block\n    spacingX     = 1.4,    -- side-to-side spacing, in TTS units (~inches)\n    spacingZ     = 1.5,    -- row-to-row spacing\n    groupGapX    = 2.4,    -- horizontal gap between combat group blocks\n    spawnHeight  = 0.5,    -- drop height above the table\n\n    -- Clear space between the tool's own front edge and the first row of\n    -- models.
